title: RONALDO: 985 GOALS, 15 FROM 1,000. NO MAN HAS EVER REACHED IT
description:
He sat out a 6-2 win. Then he quit Portugal. Then Portugal lost 4-1.

On 2 November, Cristiano Ronaldo was rested for a 6-2 Champions League win. Al Nassr scored six without him. Rotation, apparently.

Then he retired from Portugal after 23 years: 234 caps and 146 goals. Their first game without him ended 4-1 to Denmark. The banner said thank you, captain. The scoreboard said we noticed.

Now he's 985 goals into his career and 15 short of 1,000. That's five hat-tricks. No man has ever reached 1,000. He's rested and ready for Al Ahli away.

Does he make it to 1,000, yes or no? Drop your answer in the comments and we'll see who was right.
